title: Codex enclave exits 0 but its shell tool fails in nested bubblewrap
symptoms: bwrap: Failed to make / slave: Operation not permitted
Codex enclave agent exit 0 with failure category result-empty
Codex inference succeeds but the diagnostic shell command never runs
conditions: The engine is Codex and the pinned CLI (0.159.3 in the enclave image) runs its default nested sandbox inside the hardened enclave
The CLI exit code is 0 and inference succeeded, but no schema-valid result reaches /awf/out, so the invocation fails with the canonical result-empty category
Older launches omitted the trusted external-sandbox opt-in, so the enclave entrypoint did not add --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
Raw bwrap text is not retained in diagnostics; only the finite failure category is, so an old aggregate failure alone does not identify this cause
rootCause: Codex's default nested bubblewrap sandbox cannot run inside the already hardened, zero-capability enclave, so its shell tool fails while the CLI still exits 0. The fix makes AWF the sole owner of the execution policy: the shared provider environment sets AWF_ENCLAVE_AGENT_CODEX_BYPASS_APPROVALS=true for Docker, gVisor and Cloud Hypervisor, and the entrypoint then runs codex exec with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox. Task text, request fields and ambient environment cannot select or override it.

probe.expect: A Codex enclave failure with category result-empty after an engine-result event with exitCode 0 matches this finding. The projection never contains raw engine output or bwrap text, so a historical failure without the projection is unknown, not confirmed.

action: Use source whose shared provider environment sets the trusted bypass flag and whose entrypoint inserts --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox. Keep the outer confinement (non-root identity, zero capabilities, no-new-privileges, read-only root and seed, bounded noexec writable paths, proxy-only network) and keep treating a missing or invalid /awf/out result as a failure even when the CLI exits 0. Do not accept a result-empty run as success and do not let a task or request field select the policy. Hosted acceptance remains separate.
